item.title: New Best Value Request. Requirements Contract for Medical Waste Removal Services and Supplies
item.description:
Education | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-07-09

The New York City Department of Education (DOE) requests on behalf of the Division of the Office of Occupational Safety and Health to release a Best Value Request for Bid (RFB) seek qualifies and licensed vendors to provide comprehensive medical waste collection, transportation, and disposal services across school facilities citywide, services will support school-based health centers, and nursing offices.

Detailed service descriptions and requirements are provided in the Request for Bid (RFB) solicitation.

BIDS MUST BE RECEIVED BY NO LATER THAN 4:00 P.M. EST, Thursday, July 9, 2026. LATE BID SUBMISSION WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.

This RFB will result in one (1) requirement contract agreement. The awarded contract will be for a term of three (3) years with One twoyear option to extend. It is anticipated that services will commence on or about September 2026.
